FADE IN:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

We see a bustling medieval kingdom, with knights in shining armor, merchants hawking their wares, and peasants scurrying about. But amidst the chaos, we notice something peculiar. The king, a stout and jovial man named KING REGINALD, is pacing back and forth in front of a large, ornate mirror.

KING REGINALD
(to himself)
Something's missing. This kingdom needs a new aesthetic.

Suddenly, a court jester, JESTER PIPER, approaches the king.

JESTER PIPER
Your Majesty, what seems to be the matter?

KING REGINALD
I want to modernize this kingdom. Make it...futuristic.

JESTER PIPER
(confused)
Futuristic, sire? But we're in the Middle Ages!

KING REGINALD
(nodding)
Exactly! That's what I want to change. I want to make this kingdom...vaporwave.

JESTER PIPER
(skeptical)
Vaporwave, sire? But that's a...a...a music genre.

KING REGINALD
(excitedly)
Ah, yes! The music! But it's not just the music. I want to incorporate the aesthetic into every aspect of our kingdom. The architecture, the clothing, the food...everything.

JESTER PIPER
(sarcastically)
Oh, wonderful. Because nothing says "medieval" like a kingdom filled with neon lights and distorted VHS tapes.

KING REGINALD
(laughing)
Ah, Jester, you just don't understand. This is going to be a game-changer.

CUT TO:

INT. KING'S CHAMBERS - DAY

The king is surrounded by his advisors, including LORD THOMAS, LORD JENKINS, and LORD WILSON. They are all dressed in their finest attire, but with a twist. They are all wearing neon-colored wigs, and their clothes are adorned with distorted VHS tape patterns.

KING REGINALD
(to his advisors)
As you can see, I've already started implementing the new aesthetic. I want every aspect of our kingdom to reflect this...this...vaporwave vibe.

LORD THOMAS
(skeptical)
But, sire, are you sure this is a good idea? I mean, we're a medieval kingdom. We can't just...just...

KING REGINALD
(interrupting)
Just what, Thomas? Just what? You want to be stuck in the past? I want to be ahead of the curve. I want to be...vaporwave.

CUT TO:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

The kingdom is now a surreal, dreamlike landscape. The buildings are covered in neon lights, and the streets are filled with people wearing futuristic, vaporwave-inspired clothing. The king, surrounded by his advisors, rides a horse through the streets, waving to the crowds.

KING REGINALD
(to the crowd)
Long live the vaporwave empire!

The crowd cheers, and the camera pans out to reveal a massive, distorted VHS tape hovering above the kingdom.

FADE TO BLACK.

CUT TO:

INT. KING'S CHAMBERS - DAY

The king is sitting at a desk, surrounded by his advisors. He is wearing a pair of futuristic, vaporwave-inspired glasses.

KING REGINALD
(to his advisors)
I want to make this kingdom the envy of all the other kingdoms. I want to be the...the...vaporwave king.

LORD THOMAS
(sarcastically)
Oh, wonderful. Because nothing says "great leader" like a king who wears neon-colored wigs and listens to vaporwave music.

KING REGINALD
(laughing)
Ah, Thomas, you just don't understand. This is the future. And I'm the king of the future.

The advisors all nod in agreement, and the camera zooms out to reveal a massive, distorted VHS tape hovering above the king's head.

FADE TO BLACK.

CUT TO:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

The kingdom is now a fully-fledged vaporwave utopia. The buildings are covered in neon lights, and the streets are filled with people wearing futuristic, vaporwave-inspired clothing. The king, surrounded by his advisors, rides a horse through the streets, waving to the crowds.

KING REGINALD
(to the crowd)
Long live the vaporwave empire!

The crowd cheers, and the camera pans out to reveal a massive, distorted VHS tape hovering above the kingdom.

FADE TO BLACK.

THE END.
